Any adverse events.why: the abstract reports no general any-adverse-events outcome; the pooled RR 0.71 is the C. difficile-diarrhoea (CDD) relative risk (12/1493 vs 17/1488) - a different endpoint.

Serious adverse events.span: 578 (19.7%) participants had one or more serious adverse event; the frequency of serious adverse events was much the same in the two study groups
